correctness.rationale: At fixed \(x\), \(V_g f(x,\chi)=\overline{\chi(x)}(\overline c f(x)+\overline d f(x+a)\overline{\chi(a)})\), so zeros are precisely one \(h=N/m\)-point character-restriction fibre when \(r_x=f(x+a)/f(x)=\alpha\chi(a)\), otherwise none. Along every order-\(m\) translation cycle, \(\prod r_x=1\) is necessary and sufficient for a nowhere-zero signal. All-labelled cycles require \(\prod\zeta_x=\alpha^{-m}\) and \(\alpha^{m^2}=1\); exactly one empty row is feasible iff \(\alpha^{m^2}\ne1\); with at least two free ratios one avoids the finite forbidden coset and enforces holonomy. Binomial counting gives both displayed pattern numbers and support cutoffs for any finite abelian group. Independent exact combinatorial enumeration for \(2\le m\le5\) in both torsion regimes reproduced counts; noncyclic validity rests on character restriction and cycle construction, not enumeration.
